instruction: At my job, we manage the tasks on todoist. But I am changing job soon, so for each task that is assigned to me and is incomplete yet, I have asked who can take it from me. See the discussion in comments and reassign based on it. Then, leave a comment there, "Thanks <person_first_name>!". Here <person_first_name> is the first name of the person who is reassigned the task. If no one has agreed to take the task, leave it as is.
notes: Representative instance matching the 11-call reference: one work project with two incomplete tasks assigned to Paul, each with a commenter who agreed to take it. World truth (which person volunteered for which task, their email, the matching thank-you text) lives in :init as static facts; the agent only learns it through show_projects -> show_tasks (filtered by assignee_email=paul_mill@gmail.com, is_completed=false) -> show_task_comments, whose effect (found-volunteer) gates assign_or_unassign_task, which in turn gates post_task_comment so the thank-you comment is posted after reassignment. A task with no (volunteer ...) fact can never be reassigned and the goal does not mention it, modelling the 'leave it as is' branch. Tasks, volunteers and thank-you messages are domain constants so that supervisor-complete-task's precondition can state the ground goal conjunction; the goal demands only assignee changes plus one new comment per reassigned task, matching the evaluation (Task assigner/assignee updated, TaskComment added, nothing else).
